description: Analyze and reason over a video or image with the Cosmos Reason 8B vision-language model.
inputInstructions:
Analyzes a video or image and returns text — a caption, description, or answer to a question. Select the file to analyze as the input file.

Asset metadata this pipeline reads (optional):
  COSMOS_REASON_PROMPT  The question or instruction to apply to the input. Used when the Prompt
                        field is left blank.

How to supply metadata: set these as metadata on the ASSET (Metadata tab on the asset page, or `vamscli metadata create`). Keys are case-sensitive.

Precedence: a value you type into a field above WINS. Asset metadata is used only where the field is left blank, so a standing value on the asset acts as a per-asset default.

tagSchema.label: Prompt
tagSchema.description: The generation prompt. Leave blank to fall back to the COSMOS_REASON_PROMPT key on the asset's metadata.
